gpuTiers.label: Marketplace 16 GB (spot / interruptible)
gpuTiers.fits: Meets the stated 16 GB floor and nothing more.
gpuTiers.risk: Interruptible. Reclaimed without notice, which is fatal to anything measured on continuity.

gpuTiers.label: Marketplace 24 GB (dedicated)
gpuTiers.fits: Comfortable headroom over the floor; the sensible default if mining at all.
gpuTiers.risk: Small providers, variable reliability, and payment usually up front.

gpuTiers.label: Major-cloud 80 GB (reserved)
gpuTiers.risk: Ten times the marketplace rate. Needs a reward curve that pays for capability, and no such curve is published.

serverTiers.label: Budget dedicated server
serverTiers.fits: Typically 8c/16t, 64 GB, 2 x 1 TB NVMe. Note 2 x 1 TB in RAID1 is 1 TB usable, not 2 TB.
serverTiers.risk: Consumer-grade lines and best-effort support. Cheapest per month, weakest on the criterion being scored.

serverTiers.label: Standard dedicated server
serverTiers.fits: Modern 8c/16t, 64 GB ECC, 2 TB NVMe, 1 Gbps unmetered.
serverTiers.risk: The sensible default if the provisional spec holds.

serverTiers.label: Managed cloud instance + block storage
serverTiers.fits: 16 vCPU / 64 GB plus a 2 TB volume. Snapshots and quick rebuilds included.
serverTiers.risk: Most expensive, easiest to recover, and the only tier where a failed disk is somebody else’s problem.

validator.note: The airdrop IS the required stake: bonded at launch as slashing collateral, locked through the first halving, then released over 1,000 days. It is not spendable on arrival and it is at risk while bonded.

minerAt10k.airdropNote: The miner airdrop is up to 1.2bn $FLOP across an unbounded field. Per-participant value cannot be stated because nothing caps the number of miners.

unmodelled: Inference fees. Miners take 85% of every fee and validators 15%, on top of block rewards. No fee level is published, so this models block rewards only — and the omission favours mining.
How compute converts to miner reward share. "16 GB+ VRAM per unit" is a floor, not a curve.
How many miners show up. The field size is the dominant term and it is a guess.
Whether a validator seat can be won at all: 1,000 seats, selection criteria unpublished, and roughly monthly replacement of the worst 50.
Slashing. A validator stake is collateral, so the downside is not merely a missed reward.
The $FLOP price, which does not exist, and the token has no market and no wallet format.
Rental prices, which are market observations from 2026-08 and move.
